The masthead carries the working-paper identity; the body demonstrates the
type it governs — *italic*, **bold** (SemiBold), `code` set in IBM Plex Mono
and colored Blueprint, a variable $\lambda_k = \rho \sum_j w_{kj} x_j$ in IBM
Plex Math, and a footnote[^1].

[^1]: Footnotes set small in IBM Plex Serif.

| Surface | Set in |
|---|---|
| Title | Libre Franklin ExtraBold |
| Series line | IBM Plex Mono, letter-spaced |
| Body | IBM Plex Serif |
| Mathematics | IBM Plex Math |
